annotations.title: Enrich healthcare providers from the NPI Registry

description: Give NPIs, individual names, organization names, or a taxonomy with a state. Returns one row per provider from the official US NPI Registry with taxonomy, license, practice address and phone, and organization official. Invalid and unmatched lookups are free. Pay per event on Apify: 0.002 USD per provider row.

city.description: City filter. Applies to names and to the search.

individual_names.description: People, as Jane Doe, Doe, Jane, or Dr. Jane Doe MD. The registry also matches common first name aliases. A trailing * after 2 or more letters is a wildcard. Add state to narrow common names.

max_charge_usd.description: Optional. The run stops before a charge that would pass this amount. Summary rows are always returned.

max_results_per_lookup.description: Provider rows per name or search, from 1 to 1200. Default 25. The registry serves at most 1200 records per search.

npis.description: 10 digit NPIs. Each returns its record. An invalid NPI or one with no record is a free row.

organization_names.description: Organizations. The registry matches whole words, so add a trailing *, such as kaiser*, to widen the match.

postal_code.description: 5 or 9 digit postal code, with a trailing * after 2 or more digits as a wildcard.

provider_type.description: For the taxonomy, city, or postal code search: both (default), individual, or organization.

state.description: Two letter state code. Applies to names and to the search. The registry refuses state alone, so give it with a name, taxonomy, city, or postal code.

taxonomy.description: Filter or search by the registry's taxonomy wording, such as cardiovascular disease, or cardio* as a wildcard. Cardiology alone matches only Pharmacist, Cardiology. Applies to names and to the search. Does not apply to NPIs.
